_doc: Scope maps. (1) testers: which LLM tester is relevant to which product paths — verify.ps1/loop.ps1 drops a tester from VERIFY-REQUEST when its paths were not touched by this iteration's diff (override with '# all-testers' in VERIFY-REQUEST). (2) vision: which visual slug depends on which paths — used to scope the optional visual phase. Edit both for your project; the entries below are generic examples.
_matching: Matching is a plain SUBSTRING test against the list of changed files — not a glob. So '**' does nothing here, and a prefix that is too short matches too much: 'src/' in a Maven layout also covers src/test/java and src/main/resources, and the architecture tester then gets called on every single iteration. Write path prefixes that name one layer.

testers._what_it_checks: Layer boundaries, banned deps, orphan handlers, tech-stack drift. Structural analysis.

vision._doc: slug -> product paths. Slugs must match the targets of your visual test runner. If a change maps to no slug, the visual phase is skipped (incremental). A server-side project has no visual phase at all: leave features.vision off in harness.json and these rules unused.

shared._doc: Changes under these paths touch ALL slugs (shared components, themes, layout) -> full visual run.
